title: Kemono Jihen
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Tokyo occult detective Kohachi Inugami, a tanuki in human form, investigates livestock deaths in a mountain village and finds Kabane, an abused boy who turns out to be half-ghoul. Inugami takes him to Tokyo to join his agency of half-yokai youths, including ice-wielding Akira and spider-hybrid Shiki. Kabane searches for his missing parents while the team faces dangerous Kemono and the scheming fox Inari.
life_message: It holds up a found family where outcasts are accepted for what they are and protect one another.

content.note: Decapitation, venom, a clan devoured, killings among siblings (Wikipedia; AniList Gore, Body Horror).
Monster attacks and insect swarms (Wikipedia; AniList Urban Fantasy, Body Horror).
Shiki's mother forced into mating in experiments, with her breakdown (Wikipedia; MangaUpdates Rape; AniList Rape tag).
Kabane overworked and abused by his aunt; abandonment; a self-inflicted broken hand (Wikipedia; AniList Orphan).

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Fights settle many conflicts but protection, not pride, drives them.

Order vs freedom.evidence: Agency rules and Kemono society both shape life.

Civic vs kin.evidence: Search for parents and siblings; found family central (Wikipedia).

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Inugami leads; Inari rules a hierarchy of followers.

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: Folk yokai traditions shape the world.

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Survival against Kemono threats, with identity questions.

folkways.japan: Yokai, kitsune, tanuki and village outsider stigma come from Japanese folklore and rural social norms.

delivery.evidence: No source describes the delivery; summaries show the message carried by plot and character choices (to verify).
delivery.note: Its found-family message is carried by the agency's outcast members protecting one another.

winners_losers: The agency's outcasts gain a home; abusive relatives and Inari's schemes lose. Sympathy goes to found family and the mistreated.
